llm_response.reason: The website exhibits multiple scam characteristics: promises of guaranteed and high returns (up to 80% ROI), excessive urgency ('instant withdrawal'), targeting psychological weaknesses (easy profits, copy professional traders), vague and unverifiable company information, use of crypto-only payment methods (unusual and risky), domain registered just weeks ago (June 2025), lack of proper testimonials or verifiable licensing, privacy policy references that are ambiguous, and no legitimate business contact information. These strongly indicate an investment scam.
